rationale.overall: B is closer to the REFERENCE's photographic material read—organic ground grain and softer face falloff—while sharing A's composition, so it wins on a narrow material margin.
rationale.material: REFERENCE's un-planed field is irregular directional grain, which B's varied single-family texture approximates; A's repeating crosshatch reads as a mechanical overlay that flattens depth and translucency relative to the reference.
rationale.silhouette: Both takes keep the same diagonal block, top-left curl, orange under-edge, and split-ground massing with no meaningful edge or negative-space difference.
rationale.smallsize: At 128, 32, and 16 both collapse to the same dark diagonal bar, pale curl note, and orange underline on a split field with equal legibility.
